title: The Fermented Stone Library

features.name: sediment pages
features.desc-on-touch: You run your fingers across layers of stone that were once paper, once words, once living testimony. Each stratum is a year fermented into rock. You can almost read the corruption.

features.name: the stone-scribe's fist
features.desc-on-touch: A handprint pressed into cooling compost, now fossilized. The hand that held the pen became the page. The archive that reported became the archive that is reported upon.

features.name: the settling chamber
features.desc-on-touch: A pool of dark stone catching the light like still water. This is where the ferment stopped moving, where chaos decided to become record.

features.name: the mineral index
features.desc-on-touch: A filecard listing rendered in crystal. The archive's own contents, catalogued in a language that only stone speaks — percentage ferric, percentage silica, percentage testimony.

features.name: the unreadable sentence
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph carved so deep that fermentation has filled the grooves with mineral. The words are there, but they are now also the rock around them. Meaning has become structure.

reverie.title: REVERIE — at the edge of the hardening field
narr: You stand with her at the edge where the earth is cooling,
where words have stopped falling and started setting.
She says: it won't move again. Once the stone forms,
the testimony is permanent. You watch the last of the decomposition
harden into certainty, knowing something has been saved
and something else has stopped growing.

inscription: here the archive stopped decomposing and started crystallizing — growth that chose to be memory
